name: @pacsarcade/puck-changelog
description: The change-log substrate for puck-studio — a reference-pruned patch stream over Puck's onAction, with inverse patches, block attribution, a ring buffer that folds into its base, and a React bridge that rides Puck's own undo history. One log, four consumers to come: undo view-state, incremental CSS, save queue, multiplayer rebase.
